question: Tăng trưởng GMV tháng 9 so với tháng 8/2026 (%), tính cả kênh?
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' THEN (o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS sep_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-09-01' THEN (o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS aug_gmv FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments pay WHERE pay.order_id=o.order_id AND pay.status='success')) SELECT ROUND(100.0*(sep_gmv-aug_gmv)/NULLIF(aug_gmv,0),2) AS growth_pct,sep_gmv,aug_gmv FROM m;

question: Tỷ lệ đơn đã giao phát sinh hoàn trả được duyệt, cohort đơn đặt tháng 9?
gold_sql: WITH delivered_orders AS(SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' AND o.status='delivered'),returned_orders AS(SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.status='approved') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id) AS approved_return_orders,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_orders) AS delivered_orders,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id)/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_orders),0),2) AS return_rate_pct FROM returned_orders ro JOIN delivered_orders d ON ro.order_id=d.order_id;
notes: Nếu cùng một đơn có nhiều return vẫn chỉ đếm 1 đơn.
